items.title: Disney's job cuts may reveal a bigger problem for the media giant
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the real reason behind Disney's (DIS) job cuts and the broader challenges reshaping the media industry. Sozzi also looks at how the stock has been performing since John D'Amaro stepped in as CEO.

items.title: Disney plans thousands of layoffs in major cost-cutting push
items.summary:
Walt Disney Co. (DIS) plans to cut thousands of jobs, as its leadership was asked to reduce staff by 20%, according to a Bloomberg report.

Sherwood News head of markets Luke Kawa joins Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian on The 8:30 to break it down.

items.title: Why Walt Disney (DIS) Outpaced the Stock Market Today
items.summary: The latest trading day saw Walt Disney (DIS) settling at $114.38, representing a +1.12% change from its previous close.

items.title: How Job Cuts At Disney Stock Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Walt Disney is reported to be planning thousands of job cuts as part of a broad restructuring that targets around 20% annual cost savings across areas such as television, film, streaming, and theme parks, with some of the freed up budget earmarked for reinvestment in content, technology, parks, and cruise operations. items.title: Movie Theaters Are Packed Again. A Brutal Holiday Test Awaits.
items.summary: The movie industry is on track to reach $10 billion in domestic box office sales for the first time since 2019. It all depends on whether audiences show up.

items.title: Disney Plans Thousands of Layoffs, Targeting 20% Cost Savings
items.summary: Walt Disney is moving toward thousands of job cuts with the entertainment giant asking some managers to target 20% in annual cost savings, according to people familiar with the matter.  The savings could come from job eliminations as well as from expense reductions, said the people, who asked to not be identified because the discussions are private.  Bloomberg's Geetha Ranganathan joins to discuss.

items.title: Disney weighs job cuts as some managers face 20% savings goal
items.summary: Walt Disney Co (NYSE:DIS, XETRA:WDP) is considering cutting thousands of jobs as it reviews costs and looks to redirect some savings into its businesses.
